name: Act of June 22, 1874 ratifying the Sisseton and Wahpeton agreement of September 20, 1872 (18 Stat. 167)
promises: Not a treaty. The Act ratified the agreement of September 20, 1872 for the cession of lands by the Sisseton and Wahpeton (Royce, see area 538).
today: The 1872 agreement itself is recorded as kappler-1065, where no breach was found and the installments were recorded as paid.

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule pp. 874-875
Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule pp. 862-863

openQuestions: Not re-counted: the cession of area 538 is the subject of kappler-1065 and of the February 14, 1873 Act (17 Stat. 456) that first confirmed the agreement with amendments.
